items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And the saxophones was Leonard Gaye, Smoke Richardson, and Chuck -- I forget Chuck's last name.

ctx.x: And the saxophones was Leonard Gaye, Smoke Richardson, and Chuck -- I forget Chuck's last name. He was from Detroit. And of course Teddy on the piano and Bowles was on bass. I think Bowles later went to Chicago to live.
